background.description: White background, recent colour photo, face filling about 75% of the frame

notes: The official CSE 2026 notification (Note 2, How to Apply) confirms applicants must both upload a photograph AND separately capture a live photograph during the application — this preset covers only the uploaded file. The exact pixel/KB figures (350x350px, 20-300KB) come from UPSC's separate online 'Instructions and FAQs > Photos and Signature' page (upsconline.nic.in), which could not be directly fetched for this verification — multiple independent sources agree on these numbers, but confirm against that FAQ page directly before relying on the exact pixel dimensions.
